guides.title: LM Studio Chat Provider · Connection
guides.description: Use Connection in LM Studio Chat Provider.
guides.category: Runtime / LLM / LM Studio Chat Provider
guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.

steps.title: Check the local endpoint settings
steps.body: Read the endpoint details this provider expects in Connection. They should point at the local LM Studio server. If LM Studio is not running, connection attempts fail even with correct settings, so start the app before testing.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Required setup before testing
steps.body: This provider uses the Python SDK, so the environment must be able to import it. Read the requirements shown in Connection. If a requirement is missing, correct it before the test rather than assuming the model selector is wrong.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Read models reported by LM Studio
steps.body: Open the chat-model selector and inspect the models reported by the connected LM Studio service. A downloaded model and a model ready to answer are different states. If the expected model is missing, inspect the provider's connection and refresh result before entering an unverified name.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Test connection explicitly
steps.body: Use the Test connection control to confirm the SDK, endpoint and loaded model all work together. Reading selected state is not verification. On failure, check whether LM Studio is running, whether a model is loaded, then whether the Python SDK requirement is met.

steps.title: Adjust reply shaping
steps.body: Generation controls response behavior such as length or creativity. Change one value and send a short chat message to compare. Local models can respond slowly, so wait for the reply before deciding a setting had no effect.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Watch load and context limits
steps.body: Local models are limited by memory and context window. If generate settings cause the model to fail or truncate, reduce the demand rather than repeatedly raising values. Note which change preceded the failure so you can restore a working state.
